{
  "name": "room",
  "version": "0.7.0",
  "description": "Codex, Cursor and a second Claude inside Claude Code: an agent room (one chat, @mentions, handoffs) plus one-shot reviews and delegation",
  "author": {
    "name": "Brennen Barney"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/bbarney7/claude-code-mods/tree/main/plugins/room",
  "repository": "https://github.com/bbarney7/claude-code-mods",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "codex",
    "cursor",
    "multi-agent",
    "acp",
    "code-review",
    "mod"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "roomSeed": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Room: context from the main Claude session",
      "description": "What the room's agents (Codex, Cursor and the room's own Claude) learn about the main Claude conversation the room was opened from, when their session starts: none, the last turns, a summary the main Claude writes, or the full conversation (capped at 60,000 characters).",
      "default": "recent",
      "options": [
        "none",
        "recent",
        "summary",
        "full"
      ]
    },
    "roomSeedTurns": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Room: turns to share when seeding 'recent'",
      "description": "How many of the latest Claude-session turns a fresh room agent gets.",
      "default": 10
    },
    "claudeReturn": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Room: context sent back to the main session",
      "description": "What reaches the main Claude session when the room @mentions @main or you press Send room to main: just that message, the latest room messages, a summary of the room, or the whole room (capped at 30,000 characters).",
      "default": "message",
      "options": [
        "message",
        "recent",
        "summary",
        "full"
      ]
    },
    "claudeReturnMessages": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Room: messages to send back for 'recent'",
      "description": "How many of the latest room messages go with a message to Claude.",
      "default": 8
    },
    "roomEdits": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Room: what agents may do",
      "description": "inherit: the room follows the main session's permission mode (bypass gives Codex full access, Claude bypassPermissions, and answers Cursor's questions; accept edits lets them edit the repo; default makes them ask first; plan keeps them read-only). allow: they edit the repository on their own. ask: each asks you in the room before an edit; Cursor, which cannot ask, only reads.",
      "default": "inherit",
      "options": [
        "inherit",
        "allow",
        "ask"
      ]
    }
  }
}
